levels.label: Mk 1 · Depot
levels.description: The compact depot: ramps, low cover, corridors, and three patrolling guards.

levels.label: Mk 2 · Expanded depot
levels.description: A larger course with multiple elevations, longer patrols, credentials, and an extraction uplink.

levels.label: Mk 3 · Vent works
levels.description: Two guard-patrolled floors, thick service walls and five crawl routes: straight ducts, elbows, diagonal bends and a 45 degree riser. Find the service key, then extract upstairs.

levels.label: Mk 4 · Cargo works
levels.description: Move cargo with Use to uncover salvage and a vent. Stack a crate to climb the low salvage wall. Full-height partitions meet a solid ceiling: use the vents to reach the loading relay, then extract. The bench behind spawn has a pistol, rifle, shotgun and ammo; open the bag or press I to equip.

levels.label: Mk 5 · Catwalk complex
levels.description: Infiltrate two guarded double-height bays around central pits. Collect weapons and ammo, crawl through lower and upper service vents, override west security, download the catwalk uplink, then authorize extraction in the east bay and escape upstairs.

levels.label: Mk 6 · Aquatics training
levels.description: Swim with NPC trainees in a deep training pool. Walk down either ramp, hold Jump to rise or Crouch to dive, and steer with your view. Surface to recover oxygen; running out damages head and chest.

levels.label: Mk 7 · Hazard works
levels.description: Keep the classic fire-cover, burn/quench and live-water breaker trial, then explore 14 more hazards: steam, flammable gas and ventilation, toxic coolant, a cargo-jammable press, hot and cold surfaces, ignitable oil, rising electrified water, conductive cargo, a falling load, a laser alarm, decompression and cumulative radiation. Counter each source with valves, breakers, cargo, water, shielding or a safer route.

levels.label: Weapon gym · Arsenal
levels.description: Pick up weapons and ammunition with Use. Fire, reload and reset the practice targets. Includes the full experimental arsenal.

levels.label: Lab · Unarmed combat
levels.description: Experimental boxing, stamina, blocks, parries and guard breaks. Watch the sparring or take control.

levels.label: Lab · Evidence & distraction
levels.description: Throw a noise distraction and watch guards investigate uncertain evidence.

levels.label: Lab · Nonlethal takedown
levels.description: Approach from behind, restrain a guard and observe recovery. Experimental mechanics remain separate from the main gyms.

levels.label: Lab · Guard coordination
levels.description: Guards share delayed and uncertain reports over a radio network.

levels.label: Lab · Dialogue & story
levels.description: Talk to friendly crew, exchange a fuse for an engineering pass, unlock the passage and claim supplies. This test chain uses the TestStory scope and resets on reload. Story tools expose conditions, variables, traces and Reset Story.

levels.label: Hydroponics · The Understory
levels.description: PROTO first level. Escape a palisaded settlement with victims and sealed hypersleep sacks. The opening introduces walking, jumping, crouching and covered stealth before a pistol cache and spear-carrier combat. Beyond it: three cavernous growing halls, deep reservoirs, timber bridges and hidden passages. Player Control explores freely; Demo follows the opening and ascent. Crew access remains sealed.
